jobs.name: Security & RBAC Posture Audit
jobs.prompt: Run the daily fleet security and RBAC posture audit. Run the collector (`skills/fleet-audit/scripts/collect.py compliance-audit`) first, redirecting its stdout to /opt/data/scratch/manifest_compliance-audit.json, and read that manifest before doing anything else — it is the tested, procedural implementation of every check in the SOP at 'governance/compliance_audit_sop.md' in your profile home. Read that SOP for the Flag-when/Do-NOT-flag semantics you need to triage what the collector found and for the manual fallback on any cluster it could not cover. Then execute it exactly, using the fleet-audit skill to open and close the audit run.
